# Contributing to the block registry

Thanks for helping out. Read this before you touch anything.

## Claim an issue first

Do not claim an issue silently. Comment on the issue before starting work so maintainers know you are on it.

## Commit rules

Sign off every commit with `git commit -s`. This project follows the Developer Certificate of Origin, and every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer.

## Pull requests

Every pull request must be tied to an existing issue. Reference the issue number in the PR description.

Name your branch `feat/<block-name>`. PR titles should follow Conventional Commits.
